newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in all maturities.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) edged lower in all maturities amid high liquidity in the market, traders said on Wednesday.
"Swap quotes on which PHIBOR are based have been falling at a steep rate in recent days," a dealer said.
But he said rates could be nearing bottom since banks have decided to park their excess pesos in reverse repos and the Central Bank's T-bills.
Banks' liquidity had been boosted due to a reserve requirement cut and dollar purchases by the Central Bank.
